    Product brochure

    Botanical extracts, nutraceutical ingredients, aroma chemicals and pharmaceuticals

    Meet us at

    We supply formulators, brand owners and distributors with consistent, well-documented ingredients for flavor and fragrance, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical and personal-care applications. Extraction choices are made product by product, matching the method to the actives, so buyers get a specification they can build a formulation around.

    How we work

    Two extraction routes, one standard

    Botanical products ship with a Certificate of Analysis and batch documentation, with flexible MOQs.

    CO₂ supercritical extraction
    Solvent-free, low-temperature extraction that preserves volatile actives and leaves no residual solvent.
    Solvent & H₂O extraction
    Used for water-soluble and standardized actives, with defined purity and percentage grades to specification.
    Custom specifications
    We work product by product with formulators on actives percentage, particle size and private-label packaging.

    Have a formulation in mind?

    Bring us your requirement (actives, purity, particle size, packaging and volume) and our team will follow up with specifications, pricing and lead times.
